title: Path traversal in report CSV export
summary:
### Impact

A path traversal in the report CSV export allows staff users (moderators and admins) to create directories, each containing a small CSV file, anywhere the Discourse process can write on the server.  A directory planted in the plugins folder causes every Discourse process started afterwards to fail during boot.

The issue does not allow code execution, reading files, or overwriting existing files. Regular users cannot exploit it.

All versions since v2.0.0.beta8 are affected. The directory creation that leads to the boot failure was introduced in v2.5.0.beta4.

### Patches

The issue is patched in the latest version of Discourse.

### Workarounds

- Only grant moderator and admin roles to trusted users.
- Check for directories already planted in the plugins folder, and remove any incorrect entry.

Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-4ADFPFMQ.
